query:
UPDATE room_keys_versions
            SET count = (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_keys_backup
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND version = $2
            ),
            etag = CASE
                WHEN NOT $3 THEN etag
                WHEN etag ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN (etag::BIGINT + 1)::TEXT
                ELSE '1'
            END
            WHERE user_id = $1 AND version = $2
